answer: Each identity locks 80 credits as a copper deposit and files a captain-signed manifest. The manifest goes on the garden board; auditors recompute: captain key and arrival stamp must match registry and route log, with no repeated hash; each manifest links to the prior hash in a spiral chain. A mismatch burns the deposit. The k-th manifest pays 20+3(k-1); the 1000th pays 3017, so 1000 fakes lock 80000 and pay 1518500, unshared. A rented-manifest ring fails: a reused hash shows on the board and burns every identity tied to it. An honest agent pays 20 and recovers it after a clean epoch.
